purpose: Twenty additional Chrome extension articles to be published after the active 50-article schedule, five per day.

entries.title: Chrome Extensions Not Syncing: Causes, Checks, and Safe Recovery
entries.intent: Troubleshoot extension or Chrome sync symptoms without confusing browser sync with extension data backup.
entries.angle: A diagnostic flow for account sign-in, sync settings, policy limits, and local-vs-cloud expectations.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Popup Not Opening: A Practical Diagnostic Guide
entries.intent: Fix an extension action popup that does not open, while separating browser UI limits from extension bugs.
entries.angle: User-first checks followed by developer inspection of popup errors, permissions, and action configuration.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Icon Missing from the Toolbar: Find and Pin It Safely
entries.intent: Locate an installed extension whose toolbar icon is hidden or no longer visible.
entries.angle: A toolbar visibility workflow distinct from the active generic pinning guide, focused on missing-state diagnosis and profile context.

entries.title: Why a Chrome Extension Update Is Delayed: Idle State, Policies, and Checks
entries.intent: Understand why an available extension update has not installed yet.
entries.angle: Explain the idle-state requirement, update cadence, policy controls, and safe verification without duplicating manual update steps.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Settings Lost After Reinstall: What Can Be Recovered
entries.keyword: chrome extension settings lost after reinstall
entries.intent: Recover or prevent loss of extension settings after uninstalling, reinstalling, or changing profiles.
entries.angle: Separate synced settings, local data, export support, and irreversible deletion; avoid promising recovery without a backup.

entries.title: How to Back Up Chrome Extension Settings and Restore Them Safely
entries.intent: Plan a safe backup and migration workflow for extension configuration and data.
entries.angle: Compare Chrome sync, extension-native export, profile migration, and manual recovery boundaries.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Storage Limits: Local, Sync, and Session Data Explained
entries.intent: Help extension builders choose storage areas and avoid quota-related failures.
entries.angle: A developer-facing quota and data-lifecycle guide, distinct from user permissions and service-worker lifecycle articles.

entries.title: Chrome Web Store Extension Pending Review: What Developers Can Check
entries.intent: Understand what a developer can verify when a Web Store submission remains under review.
entries.angle: A process and evidence guide that avoids inventing review timelines or promising approval.

entries.title: Chrome Web Store Extension Rejected: How to Read the Reason and Respond
entries.keyword: chrome extension rejected chrome web store
entries.intent: Diagnose a rejection notice and prepare a compliant correction.
entries.angle: Map rejection evidence to code, listing, permissions, and policy review; do not advise bypassing enforcement.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Offscreen Documents: When MV3 Needs a Hidden DOM Page
entries.intent: Explain when and how an MV3 extension can use an offscreen document for DOM-dependent work.
entries.angle: A bounded API guide covering reasons, lifecycle, permissions, and debugging without duplicating service-worker basics.

entries.title: Chrome User Scripts API: Capabilities, Permissions, and Safe Use
entries.intent: Help developers understand the User Scripts API and when it differs from content scripts.
entries.angle: Clarify execution context, user-supplied code risks, permissions, and compatibility boundaries.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Content Security Policy: Common MV3 Errors and Fixes
entries.intent: Troubleshoot CSP errors in a Chrome extension without weakening website security blindly.
entries.angle: Use manifest rules, inline-code restrictions, remote-code limits, and safe debugging examples.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Web Accessible Resources: Scope, Risks, and Testing
entries.intent: Explain when extension files need to be exposed to web pages and how to limit that exposure.
entries.angle: A security-first manifest guide distinct from host permissions and content-script execution.

entries.title: Chrome Extensions in Guest Mode: What Works and What Does Not
entries.intent: Understand extension availability and data boundaries in Chrome Guest mode.
entries.angle: Compare Guest mode, profiles, and Incognito without repeating the active Incognito permissions guide.

entries.title: Can Chrome Extensions Access chrome:// Pages? Limits and Safer Alternatives
entries.intent: Explain why an extension cannot operate normally on browser-internal pages and what alternatives exist.
entries.angle: A boundary guide covering restricted URLs, user expectations, and legitimate testing paths.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Clipboard Access: Permissions, User Gestures, and Safer Patterns
entries.intent: Help users and developers understand clipboard read/write failures and permission boundaries.
entries.angle: Separate clipboard behavior from generic host permissions and explain user-gesture requirements carefully.

entries.title: Chrome Extension Background Errors: How to Inspect the Right Console
entries.intent: Find background errors in the correct extension inspection context.
entries.angle: A practical debugging route distinct from the Chrome Logger product guide and service-worker lifecycle article.

entries.title: How to Check a Chrome Extension Version and Update Status
entries.intent: Verify the installed version, update state, and source of an extension.
entries.angle: A verification guide for users and support teams, distinct from manual update instructions.

entries.title: Save and Restore Chrome Tab Groups with an Extension: What to Check
entries.intent: Choose a safe workflow for preserving tab groups and restoring them later.
entries.angle: Focus on data ownership, session recovery, and extension limitations rather than a generic tab-manager listicle.

entries.title: Chrome Extensions for a Reliable Read-Later Workflow: Capture, Review, and Export
entries.intent: Build a dependable read-later workflow without losing source context or creating duplicate saves.
entries.angle: A task-based guide focused on capture quality, export, privacy, and maintenance; distinct from generic note-taking and citation articles.
